children: Annual producer inflation in Poland accelerated to 4.2% in August 2026 from an upwardly revised 3.1% in the previous month, exceeding market expectations of 3.6%.

It marked the sixth consecutive month of producer price growth and the highest reading since April 2023, as prices rose at a faster pace in mining and quarrying (6.4% vs 4% in July), manufacturing (4.6% vs 3.5%), and electricity, gas, steam and hot water supply (1.4% vs 0.3%).
On the other hand, price growth eased in water supply; sewerage, waste management and remediation activities (2.2% vs 2.3%).
On a monthly basis, producer prices rose 0.6%, slowing from an upwardly revised 1% in the previous month.
For the January-August period, producer prices increased 1.3%.

title: Poland Producer Inflation Highest Since 2023
